name: Do I need a professional plumber for a running water meter leak, or can I fix it myself?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a professional plumber for a running water meter leak, or can I fix it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: For simple and obvious leaks, such as a dripping faucet washer or a visible running toilet, you might be able to perform a DIY fix. However, if the leak isn't readily apparent, or if it involves complex plumbing, hidden pipes, or your main water line, calling a professional plumber is highly recommended. We have specialized leak detection equipment and the expertise to accurately locate and repair leaks without causing further damage, ensuring a lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: For obvious, simple leaks, DIY might work. For hidden, complex, or main line leaks, a professional plumber is essential to accurately locate and repair the issue.
